# Simple Custom Post Order 2.9.0

Adds optional drag-to-nest for hierarchical lists and is tested with
WordPress 7.2 and PHP 8.6.

## New

- **Change an item's parent by dragging (opt-in).** On hierarchical post types
  such as Pages and taxonomies such as Categories, drag a row to the right to
  nest it under the item above, or to the left to move it back out. The dashes
  in front of the title preview where it will land, children move with their
  parent, and only positions that keep the tree valid are offered. With the
  keyboard, grab a row and press Right or Left Arrow. The new parent is saved
  in the same request as the order, through `wp_update_post()` /
  `wp_update_term()`, and only after the usual stale-order checks pass.
  Contributed by @jgramp in #156 (closes #58).
- **Off by default.** Changing a page's parent changes its URL, and in testing
  an ordinary up/down drag that wobbled 14 px sideways was enough to nest a
  row. Turn it on under *Settings → SCPOrder → Advanced Options → Parent /
  child*, or with the `scpo_allow_reparent` filter.

## Compatibility

- Tested with WordPress 7.2 RC3 on PHP 8.6 and PHP 8.5.
